newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metway says merger conditions met.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metway says merger conditions met.

text.p: Queensland-based regional bank Metway Bank Ltd said all conditions relating to its merger with financial services group Suncorp and the Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) had been satisified, allowing the merger to take effect on December 1.

The merger, to found the Queensland government-owned "mega-bank", follows a protracted takeover battle earlier this year between New South Wales-based regional bank, St George Bank Ltd, and the Queensland state government which won the battle with a bid of A$4.80 per share plus a four cent dividend.
Metway shareholders have the choice to hold onto shares in the new entity or accept the cash offer.
On November 25, Metway said Steve Jones from Australia and New Zealand Banking Group would be appointed chief executive of the merged Suncorp/Metway/QIDC.
